name: high-energy
status: calibrated: high-energy v1, confirmed by Mits approving claude-arena v003 on 2026-11-07 (phone listen). Change this file only with Mits's approval; one-off changes go in a reel's reel.json audio.profileOverrides.
basis: Every level is the loudest K-weighted (ITU-R BS.1770) 100 ms window of a sound as mixed, in dB relative to the voice's median speaking level (100 ms windows inside spoken words). A window is 'speech' when the voice there is within 12 dB of that level, otherwise 'gap'. The mixer (scripts/audio/reelmix.py) and QA (create-reel qa-core) both use this basis.

foley.about: typing, ticks, taps, paper, small UI clicks: controlled texture

accent.about: impacts, whooshes on real moves, success tones, transitions: noticeable presence

hero.about: crowd reactions, big reveals, dramatic payoffs: 1-3 per reel, each peaking in a protected pause

duck.about: speech-aware gain for effects and music: starts before a word, recovers after it, smooth in dB

bed.about: music sits behind speech, lifts in gaps, dips briefly so a hero sound reads

voicePeaks.about: gentle peak control on the voice alone before mixing, so the master limiter only catches strays
